Class Worker

java.lang.Object
Worker
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class Worker extends Object implements Runnable
The task executed by each worker thread to standardize a chunk of the dataset across three distinct phases.

Phase breakdown and synchronization:
  • Phase 1 (partial sums): Each thread calculates the sum of its assigned data chunk and stores the result in its dedicated index of the set of partial sums. Threads synchronize at the first barrier because computing the global mean (μ) requires every chunk's sum.
  • Phase 2 (squared deviations): After passing the first barrier, all threads read the set of partial sums to determine the global mean (μ) and compute the sum of squared deviations for their chunk, writing the result into a set of partial squares. Threads synchronize at the second barrier because computing standard deviation (σ) requires every chunk's squared deviations.
  • Phase 3 (normalization): After passing the second barrier, each thread computes the global standard deviation (σ) and normalizes its chunk in place as (value - mean) / stdDev.
